request.text:
Ticket (personal data masked):
When will the payroll portal be back? It says SSO authentication failed. My manager said IT promised it would be fixed by 2pm, can you confirm? I need to submit my expenses today.

Employee: Financial Analyst, Finance, London; ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 (Windows 11).

Why the automated desk stopped: Decide did not clear it for self-service (escalate is 91% likely).

What the automated desk already did: screened the ticket and masked personal data; classified it as identity, high severity; searched the knowledge base and kept 1 passage; drafted a reply and verified it (99% grounded).

Verified holding reply sent to the employee:
No restoration time has been published.
1. Expense claims can be submitted by email to the finance shared mailbox; they will be processed when the portal is back
request.instructions: You prepare escalations for a human IT technician. Use only the text. Do not suggest causes or fixes that are not stated.

summary.description: Two sentences for the technician: the employee's problem and why the automated desk stopped.
